prompt: Who was the winner of Tour de France the same year that a major catastrophic crash happened at Circuit de la Sarthe in Le Mans, France?
answer: Louison Bobet won the 1955 Tour de France, the same year as the catastrophic crash at the 24 Hours of Le Mans at the Circuit de la Sarthe.
